title: Napa Valley Aloft Hot Air Balloon Rides

services.name: balloon flight
services.desc: Our family comprises a great team, offering you a personal touch and an unforgettable experience on your Napa Valley hot air balloon adventure. Jayson, Jay, Gretchen, and Jared invite you to fly with Napa Valley Aloft Balloon Rides! The Kimball Family ballooning history goes back to the 1970s when Napa Valley was beginning to develop as a destination for wonderful wine and great restaurants. Tourism was on the rise and so were the first hot air balloon Napa companies! blurb: Founded in 1976, Napa Valley Aloft offers the most iconic hot air balloon rides in Napa Valley and has been a defining part of the region’s skyline for nearly 50 years. As we celebrate this milestone, Aloft continues to be recognized as a trusted and established hot air balloon operator in the world, delivering one of the most memorable and authentic Napa Valley balloon ride experiences
